messages.subject: Project Cedar - completed
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Priya,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Cedar exchanged and completed today. The SPA is executed, the W&I policy has incepted, the £1.2m retention is funded and the Northbank charge is being released. Bidco now owns 100% of Harrowgate Precision Castings.

We'll deal with the Companies House filings and circulate a completion bible in due course. Congratulations to the team.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0820
